s: Im achar sheerebu nitqalqel haerub ubo d' seipim: erebu, veachar kak nitqalqel haerub venitmaet mishshiuro qodem shenniknas hashshabbat, uba echad mibbene hechatzer letaqqeno lehosip alayv ad kashshiur — im ba leareb mimmin harishon, en tzarik lehodia lahem, apillu meareb alehem mishshellahem, ubilbad shello yittol pittam mibbattehem shello middatam, ella bene habbayit yittenu lo. Vaapillu im kala harishon legamre, uba leareb mechadash mishshellahem — en tzarik lehodiam. Vaapillu mi shetztzarik lehodia lo bitchillat haerub veen meorbin battechilla shello middato, kegon shebbeto patuach lishte chatzerot, sheen haerub hazzeh zekut lo bevadday, ukemo shennitbaer besimman shs"z — en tzarik lehodia lo keshennitqalqel vechozer umetaqqenim oto, shekkevan shekkebar nitratztza bo battechilla, min hassetam gam akshav yitratztzeh bo. Abal im ba leareb mimmin acher (kegon shemmittechilla haya pat chittim veakshav ba laasoto mippat orez) — im kala min harishon legamre, tzarik lehodia lekol mi shetztzarik lehodia lo bitchillat erub, sheggam akshav hu kitchillat erub, kevan shekkala min harishon legamre, veshemma lo yitratztzu bemin zeh. Vehu shemmeareb mishshellahem. Abal im mezakkeh lahem mishshello — en tzarik lehodiam apillu kala min harishon, lepi shebbevadday yitratztzu sheyyeareb alehem bekol hamminim sheyyirtzeh, kevan shehem en notenim kelum. Veim lo kala min harishon legamre, ella nitmaet mishshiuro qodem shenniknas hashshabbat, uba lehosip alayv — yakol lehosip apillu mimmin acher veen tzarik lehodiam, ap al pi shemmeareb mishshellahem:

Vekol zeh im ba lehosip mechamat shennitqalqel. Abal im ba lehosip mechamat shennittosepu diyyurin bechatzer, apillu im mezakkeh lahem mishshello — tzarik lehodia lekol mi mehem shetztzarik lehodia lo bitchillat erub, dehaynu kol mi shebbeto patuach lishte chatzerot, lepi shehosapa zo hi techillat erub lahem, ubitchillat erub en meorbin shello ladaat lekol mi shebbeto patuach lishte chatzerot apillu im mezakkeh lo mishshello, ki shemma eno chapetz kelal leareb bechatzer zo ella beacheret:

Kamma hu shiur haerub bitchillato? Bizman shehem y"ch o pachot — shiuran kigrogeret pat lekol echad. Veim hem yoter mi"ch, apillu hem elep o yoter — shiuro mezon b' seuddot, shehem y"ch gerogarot, shehem keshishsha betzim benonit pat. Veyesh omerim sheb' seuddot hen kishmoneh betzim. Vekol zeh bitchillat haerub. Abal shiyyure erub, dehaynu erub shehaya bo kashshiur venitmaet achar shenniknas shabbat rishona, venishtayyer bo apillu kol shehu — kasher ap lishar shabbatot. Vaapillu im hammeshuyyar eno kikkar shalem ella perusa. Velo ameru sheen meorbin biprusa ella bitchillat haerub. Vaapillu im nipras qodem kenisat hashshabbat — kasher im shiuro qayyam ad kenisat hashshabbat, shehare lo hitzriku shalem ella bishbil shello yabou lide machaloqet, veim ken dayyo keshehu shalem bishat hannachato. Abal im nitmaet mishshiuro qodem kenisat hashshabbat, ap im hammeshuyyar hu kikkar qatan shalem — pasul, shettechillat haerub hu techillat kenisat hashshabbat:

Im nitappesh pat haerub venipsal milleekol — hare hu kemo shekkala legamre, vetzarik leareb mechadash. Velaken nahagu bimdinot ellu laasot haerub beereb pesach mechallat matztza, sheenah memaheret lehitappesh, veod sheyyekolin leshomrah bime happesach vikolin lishmor haerub kol hashshana. Vezeh tob yoter milleareb kol ereb shabbat, ki shemma yishkechu milleareb paam achat. Zehu taam hamminhag. Abal beemet yoter tob leareb kol ereb shabbat, ki rob peamim matztza shel erub mitqalqelet umitappeshet meorek hazzeman veenah reuya laakila, vahare hi kemo shekkolta legamre. Vekol hamareb bekol ereb shabbat, yesh lo leekol haerub lemachar, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"d. Veharotzeh laasot al tzad hayyoter tob — yeareb mishshello bekol ereb shabbat, vizakkehu lekol haqqahal al yede acher, ubezeh en chashash im yitqalqel haerub shebbebet hakkeneset. Velo yebarek al shello, kevan sheyyesh erub bebet hakkeneset veshemma hu kasher, vehabberakot enan meakkebot:
